# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **In-progress 3.x servicing**

## Highlights

3.119.5 is an in-progress 3.x servicing release fixing WinUI Projection loading and adding Apple 26.0 TFM backports.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — Fixes an issue where the WinUI Projection DLL could not be located when consumed from a .NET 9 application. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Backports the 4.x-line Apple TFM alignment (versioned 26.0 libraries, unversioned app TFMs) to the 3.x servicing branch. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
